MECHANISM: Regular 5-year Treasury auctions may temporarily concentrate duration supply and dealer balance-sheet demand around the auction, producing a small yield concession that partially reverses on the next Treasury business-day observation.
WHO_PAYS: Auction participants and intermediaries demanding balance-sheet/liquidity around a concentrated primary-market supply event; a reversal may also simply reflect ordinary rate risk rather than a structural rent.
WHY_PERSIST: The auction calendar is mechanical and repeated, but any effect is likely small, crowded and exposed to macro-news confounding. A cheap public screen can determine whether expensive ZF futures/BBO reconstruction is justified.
CHEAP_DATA_NOW: Official U.S. Treasury Fiscal Data exposes Treasury Securities Auctions Data including auction_date, security_type and security_term. Official Treasury Daily Rates exposes daily par yield curve observations including 5-year yields, with 2024 and 2025 tables publicly readable/downloadable.
CHEAP_EXPRESSION: All regular nominal 5-year note auctions in a fixed calendar sample, measured using the official 5-year par yield on auction date versus the first subsequent Treasury daily observation. This is a yield-change proxy only, not executable futures PnL.
FATAL_PROBLEM: Daily par yields are end-of-day/model curve observations, not auction-time executable prices; macro releases/Fed news can dominate one-day moves; reopenings and holiday calendars must be handled mechanically; a positive average can be ordinary term-premium/rate risk or chance.
WHY_NOT_ARBITRAGED: Not established. The proposed L1 is only a cheap screen. If an effect exists, futures implementation, timing, DV01, carry, roll, bid/ask, announcement/auction timing and capacity still require strict reconstruction.

new_source_fact.reason: The parked treasury-auction-zf family explicitly allowed reactivation if a cheap public proxy was identified. Official Fiscal Data auction dates plus official Treasury daily 5-year par yields now provide that proxy without paid data or account creation.
